column1: # Benchmark set (PF-01) for scripts/benchmark.py; proposed for the owner in docs/plan/decisions.md.
# Tab-separated: name, group, sources, flags, arguments, comparison, [check arguments].
#   group        micro (tests/perf), suite (llvm-test-suite), ffmpeg (decode harness), startup (left out of means)
#   sources      repository paths or suite:<path under llvm-test-suite>, globs allowed; for ffmpeg the clip name
#   flags        extra flags for both compilers ({dir} is the first source's directory); - for none
#   arguments    the measured run's arguments, run in a directory holding links to the source directory's data
#                files; <file redirects standard input; {clip} is the ffmpeg clip
#   comparison   exact (output equals native), numeric:<absolute tolerance>, musl (output equals the sources linked
#                natively with musl: the program depends on glibc behavior, ADR-14), or status (the output holds timings)
#   check        the validation run's arguments when they differ (ffmpeg hashes every frame)
